notes.title: "I Was Lost" is compatible with Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
We're so happy to see the game running on the Steam Deck that we made this short video just to give an idea of what will be like when the game releases.
[previewyoutube=f0-yTKsfk3U;full][/previewyoutube]
I Was Lost will be playable using the buttons, touchscreen (or both!). And, of course, you will be able to rebind the keys to whatever you like.
Huge thanks to Lando for the help with the video. And don't forget to wishlist on Steam and share the game with your friends!

notes.title: I Was Lost on LAGShowcase!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165551/af125109cc9daf14c9ac919788f61b317d997fa6.jpg[/img]
The Latin American Games Showcase is an event that promotes the best games developed by Latin Americans, and it is with great joy that we announce that[b] I Was Lost is one of the games selected for the event[/b], along with 72 other incredible games that you can check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LatinAmericanGamesShowcase]here[/url].

The event will be broadcasted on Youtube on June 8th through the official LAGShocase YouTube Channel. Be sure to follow and add the event to your callendar so you don't miss it! [url=https://www.youtube.com/@LAGShowcase]https://www.youtube.com/@LAGShowcase[/url]

To celebrate, [b]our demo will be available for 7 days[/b] for you to test the game. If you haven’t already added the game to your [b]wishlist[/b], please do so now and help us by [b]sharing the game with everyone[/b] who enjoys relaxing puzzle games that also provide a good challenge for the brain and take advantage of the promotions happening on the event page.

We would love to hear your feedback on the game, so feel free to join our [url=https://bit.ly/CH3-Discord]Discord[/url] server and follow us on social media (@ch3collective on Twitter and Instagram).

A big thank you to everyone who has helped us get this far!

notes.title: Made In Brazil Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165551/270ff7696be3897b73d520ef001112ae80daa9ee.png[/img]
From the 14th to 19th February we will have totally free new Demo for you guys to preview a little of the game. We implemented several fixes and improvements based on your feedback and we are looking forward to know what you think.

If you encounter any bug or problem, contact us! You can use Discord (https://discord.gg/STrf8NNcUb), send a message on social media (@ch3collective) or by email to ch3collective@pm.me

And if you haven’t added I Was Lost to your wishlist yet, don't forget to do it so you can get updates on the game and be notified when the game launches!

notes.title: Free Demo Version Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165551/cac390dcf7001eb2db047ac36d283b5e2b207c7e.png[/img]
[h3]Hi everyone, we’re happy to announce that [b]we have a Demo[/b] for our game![/h3]

It’s available for free and it has all the elements from the full game for you to try, but with levels made especially for the Demo version.

The full version will also contain close to a [b]*hundred levels*[/b] and the possibility to play levels made by other players, so feel free to play this version and tell us what you think on our Discord Community:
https://bit.ly/CH3-Discord

And as always, you can [b]wishlist the game[/b] for when we release the full version!
